descriptions.job-1n96qhp:
About the Position

We are looking for an experienced residential life professional to serve as Residential Director for our Academy of Math and Programming (AMP) in New York City.

AMP is a residential program for recent high school graduates of diverse backgrounds who have experienced barriers to access and opportunity within advanced STEM education. 

Students spend five weeks studying mathematics, computer programming, data analysis, and game theory while building a close academic and residential community.

As Residential Director, you will live on site with students for the duration of the program and serve as a consistent adult presence outside the academic day. You will help create a safe, welcoming residential community, support students as they adjust to communal living, and respond calmly when concerns or interpersonal conflicts arise.

You will also work closely with the program’s guidance counselors, dean of students, instructors, and teaching assistants to ensure that students receive coordinated support across the classroom and dormitory. Additional responsibilities will include:

  • Living in the student residence for the duration of the program, with assigned evening and weekend shifts and scheduled overnight on-call coverage
  • Partnering with on-site security to support curfew policies and helping students follow quiet hours, study hours, and other residential expectations
  • Conducting regular cleanliness checks of student rooms and common spaces, and reinforcing shared expectations for upkeep
  • Monitoring students who stay in the residence because they are sick and unable to attend class
  • Supporting daily check-ins and headcounts in coordination with the guidance counselor 
  • Encouraging responsible behavior and helping students set healthy boundaries around socializing, sleep, and well-being
  • Responding to student needs and escalating health, safety, or well-being concerns to the appropriate program staff
  • Supporting supervision and logistics for evening and weekend activities

This is a temporary, full-time summer position with evening and weekend work and scheduled overnight on-call responsibilities. The program will run from late June through early August. Jane Street deeply values the quality of our educational programming, and we compensate our high-caliber staff accordingly. Travel and housing will be provided.

About You

  • Have experience working in residential education, student life, summer camps, boarding schools, college housing, or a similar setting
  • Experienced with supporting older teenagers or young adults
  • Mature, calm, and dependable, with sound judgment and clear personal boundaries
  • Comfortable setting expectations, addressing routine conflict, and responding to unexpected situations
  • A thoughtful communicator who works well with students, families, and program staff
  • Able to handle sensitive student matters discreetly and escalate concerns appropriately

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.
descriptions.job-1wz50yl:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Figure, you will create the first conversation with our largest prospective partners. You will work a named account list rather than a shared lead queue, so you get to know a defined set of companies well and build a point of view on why Figure matters to each one. You will research those accounts, map the people who own the problem we solve, run outbound across email, phone, and LinkedIn, and hand off meetings with enough context that the Account Executive (AE) can run a real discovery call.

This is a role for someone who has already prospected into large, complex organizations, is willing to do the research that makes cold outreach land, and is building toward a closing seat.

What You’ll Do

  • Own outbound into a named list of enterprise accounts. Run multi-channel sequences across email, phone, and LinkedIn. Carry a monthly target for qualified meetings and keep activity, notes, and next steps accurate in the CRM.
  • Build a point of view on every account before you reach out. Identify who owns the problem Figure solves, map more than one path into the organization, and write outreach that references something specific rather than something generic.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound interest against fit, timing, and who else needs to be in the room. Hand the AE the context behind the meeting, not just the calendar invite.
  • Build account plans with the Account Executives you support. Agree on which accounts matter this quarter, who you are trying to reach inside each account, and what the entry point is. Bring what you hear in the field back so messaging and target lists get sharper.
  • Partner with Marketing on campaigns, target lists, and conferences. Build the list ahead of an event and follow up on every conversation the team has onsite.
  • Keep the CRM accurate. Flag stale contacts, wrong titles, and duplicate accounts so the team is not working off records that no longer hold.

What We Look For

  • 2+ years in a sales development, business development, or comparable outbound role
  • At least one year prospecting into enterprise accounts where more than one person has to say yes
  • A record of hitting or exceeding a meetings or pipeline target
  • Comfort cold calling and cold emailing people who did not ask to hear from you
  • Writing that is short, specific, and clear. You can explain what a company does and why it should care in a few lines
  • Research ability. You can read a company’s site, filings, and public commentary and find the reason to reach out
  • Discipline on activity and follow-through. You work a plan and keep the pipeline accurate
  • Working command of CRM and sales engagement tools
  • Resilience. Most outreach gets no response, and you keep going anyway
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for conferences and team meetings
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience selling into financial institutions or another heavily regulated buyer
  • Background in lending, home equity, mortgage, or payments
  • Experience as an early SDR in a new segment or channel, where you helped build the motion
  • Experience building account plans alongside enterprise Account Executives

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $60,326 - $77,688/yr
  • On-target earnings: $87,472 - $112,647
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 11 observed holidays and PTO plan
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave
  • Continuing education reimbursement

Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice.

Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.
descriptions.job-0aoekgt:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Payment Interfaces builds and operates the APIs and services that power payment experiences across Block, including Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. Our systems process payment traffic worldwide, helping sellers accept payments and customers move money reliably and securely.

You’ll design, build, and scale customer-facing payment APIs and the critical systems behind them. You’ll bring experience in payments, lead complex projects from design through production, and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll learn the specifics of Block’s products and payment processing on the job.

This is a hands-on engineering role with ongoing operational responsibility. Alongside building new capabilities, you’ll maintain high-volume production systems, participate in on-call and incident response, and make improvements that prevent recurring problems. You’ll use AI throughout your work while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of what you ship.

You Will

  • Design, build, maintain, and scale customer-facing payment APIs with clear contracts, predictable behavior, and compatibility that developers can rely on.
  • Lead complex projects end to end: clarify requirements, evaluate trade-offs, plan incremental delivery, and own testing, rollout, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Operate critical payment systems serving worldwide traffic. Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, investigate incidents, and follow through on fixes that improve reliability.
  • Improve performance, observability, fault tolerance, and security. Use automation to reduce repetitive operational work and make systems safer to change.
  • Work with product and engineering partners across Block to turn payment requirements into reusable capabilities.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for design, implementation, testing, and debugging. Critically evaluate their output and help teammates adopt approaches that improve quality and delivery.
  • Shape technical decisions within the team and develop others through design reviews, code reviews, documentation, and mentoring

You Have

  • Experience building, maintaining, and scaling customer-facing financial or payment APIs, together with a strong understanding of payments. This is a requirement for the role.
  • Experience designing and operating high-volume, highly available distributed systems where correctness, security, and reliability matter.
  • An understanding of payment API concerns such as idempotency, retries, asynchronous processing, backward compatibility, and handling partial failures without compromising financial correctness.
  • A record of leading complex engineering projects from unclear requirements through production, making technical trade-offs, and coordinating work with partner teams.
  • Experience diagnosing production issues and improving systems through monitoring, incident response, and preventive engineering.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering tools and the judgment to validate generated code, protect sensitive data, and recognize when deeper investigation is needed.
  • Clear written communication and experience helping other engineers develop their technical skills.
  • A minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • Kotlin
  • Go
  • TypeScript
  • AWS
  • Kafka

We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.

We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible. descriptions.job-1x8a8gt:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

As a Product Operations Specialist for Ramp Travel, you will help build and scale the workflows that make business travel simple, reliable, and well-controlled for our customers. You will own the operational health of meaningful parts of the Travel product experience, from booking and policy workflows through expense automation and issue resolution.

You will work at the intersection of customer needs, product development, and operational execution. In close partnership with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, customer-facing teams, and external travel partners, you will use data and customer feedback to identify friction, shape the roadmap, improve product quality, and support high-impact launches.

Beyond the Travel vertical, you will contribute to the systems and tooling that enable Ramp's Product and Engineering organizations to scale. You will use AI tools to improve release management, customer-feedback collection, internal enablement, and support processes, while directly shipping improvements that reduce customer friction.

*Please note that this Product Operations role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 2 days/week*

What You’ll Do

  • Own the voice-of-customer loop for Travel by systematically capturing, analyzing, and prioritizing feedback from customers, CX, Sales, and internal stakeholders

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design to translate customer feedback and operational insights into actionable product requirements, recommendations, and roadmap priorities

  • Build product analytics and use data to identify opportunities to improve adoption, booking success, policy compliance, supportability, quality, and overall traveler experience

  • Own launch operations for new Travel features, from alpha through general availability, including release readiness, documentation, internal enablement, and feedback loops

  • Directly ship product improvements, including UX fixes and operational tooling, using AI and low-code tools to reduce customer friction quickly

  • Design and improve scalable operating systems for issue escalation, incident management, release readiness, supportability, and internal communication

  • Identify and automate manual processes that help Ramp scale while improving consistency and reliability for customers and internal teams

  • Manage operational relationships with relevant travel partners and vendors, including monitoring performance, surfacing issues, and supporting joint improvement plans

  • Become a subject-matter expert in the end-to-end Travel customer experience and connect daily customer pain points to the teams best positioned to solve them

What You Need

  • 3+ years of experience in product operations, product management, strategy and operations, consulting, or a customer-facing analytical role, ideally supporting B2B SaaS or fintech products

  • Experience driving complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem identification through execution and measurement

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to size opportunities, assess product performance, and identify customer friction; SQL proficiency preferred

  • Experience translating qualitative and quantitative customer feedback into clear product recommendations, requirements, and operational processes

  • A track record of investigating root causes and developing durable solutions to recurring customer or operational problems

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous and technically complex environments, with the ability to create clarity across multiple stakeholders

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messages for product, technical, operational, and customer-facing audiences

  • A bias toward action, strong prioritization skills, and the ability to ship improvements quickly while measuring impact

  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, or directly improve product and operational experiences

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with business travel, expense management, travel booking, or travel technology

  • Experience working with external partners or vendors in an operational capacity

  • Experience with Retool or other low-code tooling platforms

  • Experience in management consulting

  • Technical programming experience, such as Python, Java, or React

About Our Teams

  • Spend Management owns our core spend product, including card issuance, reimbursements, and travel & entertainment to control spend

  • Intelligence owns the reporting, savings, and price intelligence products to help companies make better financial decisions

  • Bill Payments owns our invoice management, accounts payable, and B2B payment capabilities

  • Risk owns our underwriting and financial products that determine which businesses to approve and how to manage risk

  • Growth owns onboarding, activation and retention products to help our customers be successful on the Ramp platform

  • Accounting owns creating intelligence in our accounting platform, saving finance teams time and money

  • Mobile owns our mobile app development and mobile strategy

descriptions.job-19gah7h:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is seeking a Critical Vendor Manager to own the vendor relationship program for Riot's maintenance and repair critical vendors — the trade vendors (electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety, water treatment, and similar categories) that perform maintenance and repair work across the data center portfolio. 

You will design and run the vendor performance management program: KPI tracking and scorecarding in both directions — Riot's assessment of vendors, and a defined path for vendors to provide constructive feedback on Riot — continuous-improvement tracking, and program-level effectiveness evaluation. Day-to-day vendor relationship management sits with site teams; this role owns the program framework, standards, and metrics they operate within. You will execute and assure against the Vendor Management Standard, own vendor qualification, and maintain the Approved Vendor List.

This position is remote/hybrid, with regular travel to the Rockdale or and Riots sites.

What you'll do

  • Own the vendor relationship program for maintenance and repair critical vendors across the portfolio — setting program structure, governance, and performance metrics, and evaluating program effectiveness at the portfolio level 
  • Design and maintain vendor performance scorecards and KPI tracking for maintenance and repair critical vendors, covering quality, safety, schedule adherence, and conformance to the Vendor Management Standard 
  • Build and run the reciprocal feedback process — vendors formally scoring Riot's performance as a partner, with a defined path for vendors to provide constructive feedback 
  • Set and track continuous-improvement metrics in partnership with vendors, driving shared improvement initiatives rather than one-directional scorekeeping 
  • Serve as the escalation intermediary for site teams raising vendor performance or coverage issues, working the issue to resolution or to a documented corrective action 
  • Execute vendor selection evaluations and onboarding verification for maintenance and repair critical vendor scopes, in partnership with site Critical Operations Managers and per the Vendor Management Standard 
  • Own vendor qualification and Approved Vendor List administration by maintaining the performance data and evidence that qualification reviews depend on 
  • Own contract renewal timing and coverage-gap tracking for critical vendors — flagging warranty and contract expirations before they become coverage lapses 
  • Partner with the Maintenance Strategy Manager on which maintenance scopes are vendor-performed, ensuring vendor statements of work stay aligned to the governing equipment strategy 
  • Maintain vendor performance and nonconformance records as audit-ready evidence supporting SOC 2 scope 

What you'll have

  • 7+ years of experience in vendor/supplier management, contract management, or vendor performance management within data center, industrial, or other critical infrastructure environments 
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered 
  • Ability to travel 50% of the time 
  • CPSM or a similar procurement/vendor management certification, strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience building or running a vendor scorecard/KPI program, ideally with a reciprocal (two-way) feedback component 
  • Experience with critical infrastructure trade vendor categories — electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety, water treatment, or similar 
  • Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills; comfortable serving as an escalation point between internal teams and external vendors 
  • Familiarity with vendor risk/compliance screening (insurance, safety program review) and SOC 2 or similar compliance frameworks a plus 

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Competitive Salary: $150,000-$165,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant. 
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. 
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans. 
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work. 

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
descriptions.job-1sg8i3h:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Palo Alto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.

BitGo is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build and evolve the ledger systems behind our clients' balances, trading positions, and financial reporting. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering and accounting — designing the double-entry ledger primitives that other engineering teams build on, and making sure new products are designed with financial correctness in mind from day one rather than retrofitted after launch.

This is a rare role for someone who genuinely understands accounting fundamentals and wants to apply that knowledge to hard distributed-systems problems in a live financial platform.

What You'll Do

  • Design and extend our core ledger — accounts, postings, and the account-type/ledger structures that every financial product is built on.
  • Own the chart-of-accounts and reporting surface that connects engineering data to financial statements and downstream reporting.
  • Work across the boundary between on-chain data and off-chain books: balance verification, reconciliation, and proof-of-reserve style mechanisms.
  • Partner with engineering teams early in the design process to make sure new features correctly model legal entity ownership, ledger placement, pricing, and reconciliation paths — before they ship, not after.
  • Design data models that can absorb new financial products (margin, lending, staking, tokenized assets, and more) cleanly, without repeated painful migrations.

What We're Looking For

  • Real, working knowledge of accounting fundamentals: double-entry bookkeeping, chart-of-accounts design, financial statements (P&L, balance sheet), and what reconciliation and audit actually require in practice.
  • 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, with a track record of owning data-model design for systems where correctness is the product, not just uptime.
  • Strong instincts for extensible system design — schemas and APIs that can grow with new requirements instead of requiring repeated rework.
  • Comfort reading and critiquing technical designs across multiple systems, not just writing your own.
  • Strong cross-functional communication — you'll work directly with Finance, Data Engineering, and Product on shared designs.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in crypto or blockchain infrastructure — on-chain balance models, custody, or wallet architecture.
  • Experience with event-driven or Kafka-based service architectures.
  • Prior experience in an embedded "accounting architecture" or financial-systems design-review role at a fintech or crypto company.

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

  • Competitive base salary, bonus, and stock options
  • 100% company-paid health insurance for employee, partner, and dependents
  • Up to 4% 401k company match
  • Paid parental leave, Paid vacation
  • Free commuter/parking pass
  • Free custom lunches and snacks
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and an inspiring environment

Benefits may vary based on location.

Pay Transparency Notice:

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $180,000 and $220,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.
descriptions.job-1cdgftp:
Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Software Engineer Intern, Trading

Talos is seeking a Software Engineering Intern to join our Trading team for the Summer 2027. This intern will work on a critical project related to our high-performance trading systems, contributing to tools that support trading decision-making and performance evaluation. Success in this role will involve designing and building components that enhance our algorithmic capabilities while adding new features to existing infrastructure.

Want to learn more about Talos’s engineering culture? Check out Sonic, our first open-source project which allows Talos to achieve microsecond network stack latency in Go: https://github.com/talostrading/sonic

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the Trading team to define project scope, requirements, and milestones

  • Prepare design documentation and actively participate in architectural discussions with team members

  • Build features in Go to enhance Talos's Order Management System (OMS), which is responsible for making all trading related decisions for orders submitted into Talos to ensure best execution

  • Add analytics and metrics to measure impact of your changes while incorporating feedback and iterating based on team input

  • Demonstrate project progress through regular demos

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Architecture, Strategy, and Leadership: Co-own the end-to-end MaaS system design with the Principal Architect, authoring decision records and defending technical trade-offs. Drive the platform through its maturity roadmap by delivering operable, measurable capabilities rather than mere demos. Lead technical execution by setting stringent Go and API standards, mentoring engineers, and aligning cross-functional teams.
  • Inference Gateway and API Surface: Own the wire compatibility contract for major formats (OpenAI, Anthropic), supporting advanced eatures like streaming, tool calling, and structured output. Evolve the routing tier to handle load-aware, model-aware, and prefix-cache-aware endpoint selection with robust circuit breaking and fallback mechanisms. Run versioning and deprecation as a published contract to guarantee external customer code stability across underlying changes.
  • Performance Optimization and Model Lifecycle: Maximize platform economics and performance by optimizing token throughput, KV cache tiering, and time-to-first-token (TTFT) latency at the p95/p99 levels. Mature the model serving control plane by integrating deployment tooling, LoRA multiplexing, and cold-start-aware autoscaling directly with the Kubernetes fleet. Treat regressions in cost-per-million-tokens or latency metrics as critical system incidents.
  • Global Topology and Reliability (SLOs): Scale the platform to a globally distributed architecture featuring regional inference pools, capacity-aware failovers, and an active-active control plane. Define, publish, and rigorously defend strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs) baselined against actual system performance rather than aspirations. Ensure operational resilience through peak-concurrency load testing, robust on-call runbooks, and predictable load-shedding during overloads.
  • Security, Identity, and Multi-Tenant Isolation: Enforce fail-closed authorization, robust multi-tenant isolation, and zero-retention data paths across the network, cache, and storage layers. Manage the complete lifecycle of API keys and OAuth credentials while distributedly enforcing rate limits and quotas without relying on client-supplied identifiers. Design strict abuse, rate, and prompt-injection controls, treating all user and model-generated content as untrusted data.
  • Token Metering and Billing Cor
  • Rectness: Build an idempotent, exactly-once metering system to capture uncached, cached, output, and reasoning tokens accurately across all requests. Maintain a high-volume usage ledger that enforces prepaid spend caps asynchronously and reconciles perfectly with the invoicing system. Safeguard business integrity by treating any metering or billing defect as a critical revenue and trust incident.
  • Safe Migrations and Observability: Execute zero-regression, incremental platform upgrades using strangler-style replacements, shadow traffic, and stateful dual-writes. Deliver end-to-end request tracing and cost telemetry, defining internal schemas for token and quality attributes. Enforce absolute log hygiene by ensuring prompts, completions, and PII are never retained outside of explicit, consented policies.

How you will stand out:

  • Bring 8+ years of backend engineering experience, including 3+ years owning a high-traffic, multi-tenant API platform for paying customers. Act as a senior technical voice who can collaborate closely with architects, write rigorous design documents, and commit to executing architectural decisions effectively.
  • Demonstrate expertise in scaling distributed systems through multi-region active-active deployments, caching, backpressure, and targeted performance engineering that measurably lowers unit costs. You must have a proven track record of safely executing zero-downtime brownfield migrations for stateful subsystems—like metering or ledgers—without regressions or accounting gaps.
  • Possess deep hands-on proficiency with Go-based services, production Kubernetes (including Envoy and GPU-aware scheduling), and the architectural trade-offs of datastores like PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kafka. Additionally, you will drive operational visibility by owning end-to-end observability strategies using OpenTelemetry and high-cardinality analytics stores.
  • Apply a systems-level understanding of LLM serving to manage complexities like server-sent-event streaming, KV/prefix caching, and the trade-offs between time-to-first-token (TTFT) and throughput. Leverage this foundation to build highly reliable, exactly-once metering and billing systems that accurately reconcile billions of events under partial failure conditions.
  • Enforce strict multi-tenant security disciplines by designing fail-closed authorization, mandating verified identities, and guaranteeing absolute cross-tenant isolation. Bring operational maturity to a revenue-bearing platform by carrying on-call responsibilities, running blameless incident reviews, and translating outages into structural improvements.

What you will experience working with us:

  • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
  • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
  • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
  • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
  • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
  • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

descriptions.job-0zqaba5:
The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Compliance Core builds and operates the platform that customers rely on to evaluate blockchain risk in real time and continuously monitor activity across billions of transfers. Our systems screen transfers and withdrawals, reassess exposure as new information arrives, aggregate risk at the user and organization level, and power datasets used by other teams and customers.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team and shape the next generation of this platform. You’ll help decide what to evolve, rebuild, or retire, and sequence those changes while keeping our systems reliable for every customer. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for the team’s growth, delivery, and operational health.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Lead the platform’s modernization. Set technical direction with the team, make architectural trade-offs, and turn complex changes into incremental migrations with clear milestones and safe rollouts.

  • Stay hands-on. Review code, write and challenge design documents, contribute prototypes or targeted fixes, and work directly with engineers to resolve difficult technical problems and production incidents.

  • Build and develop the team. Hire exceptional engineers, set clear expectations, provide candid feedback, manage performance, and support career growth. Create an environment where people can challenge ideas, take ownership, and do their best work.

  • Own delivery with your partners. Work with Product and upstream teams to turn customer needs and industry changes into an executable roadmap. Make priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs explicit, and follow through on commitments.

  • Make production operations sustainable. Set standards for reliability, latency, throughput, and data correctness. Improve observability, testing, incident response, and on-call practices so the platform can scale

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Experience building and operating high-throughput, event-driven distributed systems

  • Strong hands-on engineering judgment. You can work through implementation details, identify the real constraints in a design, and help the team make sound architectural decisions.

  • Experience managing engineers, including coaching, performance management, and career development, with evidence of improving both team effectiveness and engineering quality.

  • A track record of delivering complex technical initiatives across teams, breaking ambiguous problems into manageable steps, and balancing immediate customer needs with longer-term platform investment.

  • A collaborative leadership style: you welcome challenges, explain your decisions, and help engineers develop the judgment and ownership to lead work themselves.

  • Interest in blockchain and cryptocurrencies, or eagerness to learn.

Nice to have:

  • Experience modernizing or migrating critical production systems while maintaining service continuity.

  • Familiarity with JVM services in production.

  • Experience operating customer-facing systems with strict latency and availability requirements.

  • Background in compliance, payments, fraud, or another regulated domain.

  • Blockchain protocol knowledge.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role 

The North American Mid-Market Sales team at Cash App and Afterpay is responsible for driving revenue across our commerce payments products, giving merchant partners access to one of the largest and most engaged networks of next-generation consumers. We partner with high-growth and established brands across retail, fashion, beauty, travel, QSR, home, health and wellness, ticketing, and other commerce categories to help them acquire customers, increase conversion, and grow profitably.

We are looking for an experienced Mid-Market Account Executive to build and expand relationships with high-potential merchants across North America. You will own a portfolio of prospective merchants, create new pipeline, lead a consultative sales process, and close new business across Cash App Pay and Afterpay.

You will work with founders, executives, and leaders across commerce, marketing, payments, finance, and technology. Internally, you will coordinate partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Risk, Sales Strategy, and Operations.

In this role, you will independently own complex sales workstreams, make informed tradeoffs, and influence deal strategy and execution within your area of responsibility. Success requires balancing high-touch relationship development with a structured and repeatable sales process.

You will:

  • Own a portfolio of mid-market opportunities from initial prospecting and qualification through discovery, negotiation, contracting, launch, and handoff.
  • Develop account plans that identify merchant priorities, key decision-makers, potential blockers, and revenue opportunities.
  • Build pipeline through outbound outreach, market research, internal lead assignments, vertical insights, events, referrals, and partner introductions.
  • Qualify and prioritize opportunities based on merchant fit, revenue potential, product alignment, implementation requirements, and likelihood to close.
  • Lead discovery with business and technical stakeholders to understand merchant priorities, customer needs, payment flows, and implementation requirements.
  • Build merchant-specific business cases and sales narratives that connect Cash App Pay and Afterpay’s capabilities to customer acquisition, conversion, and growth goals.
  • Develop commercial proposals and negotiate pricing, financial terms, contracts, procurement requirements, and implementation dependencies.
  • Coordinate deal teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Risk, Sales Strategy, and Operations.
  • Manage deal progress using defined milestones, next steps, stakeholder ownership, and internal approval requirements.

  • Bring merchant feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights back to Product and go-to-market teams.
  • Contribute to sales processes, enablement materials, and operating rhythms that improve pipeline quality, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, and win rates.
  • Deliver against individual revenue and sales targets.
  • Represent Cash App and Afterpay in merchant meetings, industry events, and networking forums.

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B sales, business development, partnerships, or a related go-to-market role, preferably in commerce, payments, fintech, SaaS, retail technology, or another fast-moving technology environment.
  • A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota and closing mid-market or complex commercial deals.
  • Strong prospecting and pipeline-generation skills, including comfort building new business through outbound outreach, market research, partner referrals, events, and executive networking.
  • Executive presence with the ability to earn trust, ask strong questions, influence senior stakeholders, and tailor communication to founders, functional leaders, and cross-functional buying committees.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills, including comfort working through pricing, legal terms, procurement, implementation dependencies, and internal approval processes.
  • Comfort using data to build a business case, prioritize opportunities, inspect pipeline quality, and communicate tradeoffs.
  • Product curiosity and technical fluency, especially around payments, commerce, customer acquisition, marketing, and merchant growth.
  • A self-starter mentality and comfort operating through ambiguity, frequent change, and evolving priorities while still delivering results.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to lead workstreams without formal authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build concise, compelling narratives for internal and external audiences.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to help build better team processes, enablement materials, and operating rhythms.
  • A willingness to travel for merchant meetings, industry events, and internal team moments.

descriptions.job-11nqhct:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Fraud Investigation team’s mission is to ensure Robinhood customers have swift identification and resolution of fraud-related issues. We do this by interacting with customers when their accounts encounter fraud, placing temporary restrictions on accounts if needed, investigating customer-surfaced and RH-identified fraud, communicating in a timely manner, and efficiently restoring and remediating accounts to their pre-fraud status. We train and employ skilled and knowledgeable investigators, deliver consistent and high-quality support, and minimize impact from fraud losses to protect our customers and our company's financial health.

As a Fraud Operations Intern, you will conduct an end-to-end fraud investigation of accounts that have any concerns of fraud, with the ultimate goal of protecting our customers and minimizing fraud exposures to the firm. descriptions.job-1l0nuxp:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About Connect

While accepting payments on the internet has become easier over the past several years, due in large part to the advent of modern payments APIs, the internet infrastructure for routing these same payments—to suppliers, sellers, partners, service providers, and recipients—remains outdated.

Connect is Stripe’s leading product for marketplaces, on-demand services, ecommerce site builders, invoicing platforms, professional SaaS products, fundraising platforms, rental management platforms, and more. By using Connect, users in each of these categories can link multiple parties to exchange goods or services. These users rely on Connect for the crucial function of routing payments reliably between these parties.

By powering fast, flexible, compliant, and cost-efficient payment routing on the internet, Connect not only spurs the creation of innovative business models but also enables organizations—whether businesses, nonprofits, or government agencies—to bring previously offline payments online.

Why this role

This is a chance to define a foundational product area at Stripe. You will turn a fast-changing set of user and product needs into durable platform primitives that work across products, industries, and geographies.

The role combines high-leverage strategy with hands-on product execution. You will work through ambiguous, consequential questions like: what should a platform be able to model? What should be simple by default but flexible when needed? How can Stripe make complex financial infrastructure feel effortless for a platform and its users? 

The outcome of your work will compound. The abstractions you help create will be reused across Connect and Stripe, shaping what new products platforms can build and how quickly they can bring them to market.

What you’ll do

As a Product Manager on Stripe’s Connect team, you will shape the strategy and oversee the execution of high-impact initiatives serving modern marketplaces and software platforms.

Product development at Stripe is highly collaborative. You will work closely with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams. You will also engage directly with customers and present your plans to Stripe’s leadership team.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and advance a compelling product vision for Connect
  • Devise the strategy for high-impact initiatives serving modern marketplaces and software platforms
  • Translate product strategy and customer needs into clear product requirements
  • Oversee execution across the teams involved in delivering these initiatives
  • Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams
  • Meet with customers to understand their needs and gather feedback
  • Present product plans to Stripe’s leadership team and incorporate feedback

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • More than three years of product management experience
  • A computer science background or equivalent experience
  • Strong product judgment
  • The ability to lead products that require coordination across multiple teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Persistence and resourcefulness in driving successful outcomes for products and teams
descriptions.job-06qdkf1:
About Mesh

At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!

Overview

We're looking for a Solutions Architect to guide customers from signed contract to live and scaling. You'll be the technical expert on our APIs and SDKs, designing implementation strategies, mentoring customer eng teams, and building playbooks that help companies across fintech, iGaming, PSPs, and top exchanges ship faster. You'll work closely with Sales (who owns the commercial relationship) and partner with Solutions Engineers and Support.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a trusted solutions consultant, driving fast, successful customer implementations and adoption
  • Design and deliver post-sales solutions (analytics, processes, documentation, infrastructure) that accelerate time to value
  • Optimize tools and data (Gong, Pylon, Kapa, Datadog, Amplitude, AI self-service) to improve workflows and customer experience
  • Guide customer engineering teams on SDK and API best practices to reduce timelines and scale rollouts
  • Triage and resolve technical issues across customers and internal teams to maintain momentum
  • Create playbooks and implementation guides to speed onboarding and drive usage
  • Partner cross-functionally and with executives, leading technical deep dives and platform optimization
  • Stay current on crypto/fintech trends; travel occasionally (~1x/month)

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • 3+ years in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, technical project management, or support engineering—ideally leading implementations in a startup environment
  • Strong communicator who builds trusted relationships with customers and cross-functional partners
  • Proven hands-on experience designing, using, and troubleshooting APIs and integrations
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in APIs, SDKs, and modern tooling (API management, reporting, AI/automation)
  • Working knowledge of crypto and fintech, including blockchain technology, digital assets, regulatory considerations, and real-world use cases
  • Experience on early-stage or founding teams strongly preferred

The compensation range provided may span multiple career levels and will be narrowed during the interview process based on factors including a candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. For candidates outside of New York or San Francisco, compensation will be adjusted to reflect the applicable market and location-based pay band. The base salary range listed excludes commission (if applicable), equity, and benefits. The pay range represents the minimum and maximum target for new-hire compensation. Actual compensation may vary and may be higher or lower depending on individual circumstances.

Pay Range
$140,000—$180,000 USD

Why You’ll Love It Here

At Mesh, you're not stepping into a typical role—you're joining a rocket ship in mid-liftoff. You'll tackle complex, meaningful problems that actually move an industry forward, working alongside a sharp, motivated team that moves quickly, collaborates deeply, and expects everyone to operate with ownership. This is the kind of place where you'll see your work ship fast, make real impact, and be able to point to something and say, "I built that." You'll grow fast, level up your skills, and get a front-row seat to how a high-growth company scales from the inside, with competitive comp, solid benefits, and room to stretch your craft all coming standard. If you're energized by building, learning, and shaping something big—this is where you'll want to be.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our San Francisco, New York, and Bangalore hubs are expected to work from the office at least 40% of the time (approximately two days per week). This expectation may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional in-office requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process. Our hybrid approach is designed to balance meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making with the flexibility to work remotely. We believe this structure supports strong execution while preserving autonomy and focus time.

How We Care For Our Team

We believe great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That starts with competitive salary and equity that grows as you and the company grow, plus comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. We offer unlimited PTO—and we mean it. Take the time you need to recharge and show up at your best.

We're invested in your growth with a dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and certifications. Work from wherever you're most productive with our remote-friendly approach, and count on having the top-tier tools and equipment you need to do exceptional work.

Mesh Pay is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
descriptions.job-0uua0yl:
About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

Revenue Operations at Digital Asset is responsible for the tools, data, processes, and enablement that let our go-to-market teams sell a genuine paradigm shift to some of the most demanding buyers in the world. We are in the middle of a significant build-out — new sales tools, redesigned processes, and the reporting layer that sits on top of both.

We're hiring a GTM Program Manager to be the operational backbone of that work. This is a hands-on role. You will own the RevOps project plan, run the vendor and consulting relationships to implement new tools, build the training materials, chase down the decisions, and keep every workstream in the RevOps portfolio moving. When a change needs requirements written, a systems integrator needs to be held to a deadline, or the sales team needs to actually learn the new tool, that is where you come in.

You will become the expert on our Sales tool portfolio including Granola, Wispr Flow, Clay, Momentum and any others we may implement. We are an AI first group, so a willingness to jump in and be part of our AI strategy is important. You are the first point of contact and go-to person the Sales team interacts with to handle questions on our sales tools. There is one exception: Salesforce.com, which is fully owned and managed by a Technical lead. A general knowledge of Salesforce.com will be very helpful to you in this role since it is the source of truth for our Sales reps. 

You'll work across Sales, Client Experience, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and IT. You'll rarely have direct authority over the people you depend on, and you'll need to move things forward anyway. If you like being the person who makes a function run — the one who knows the status of everything and lets nothing quietly stall — this role is built for you.

Responsibilities:

Program and Project Management

  • Own and maintain project plans across the full RevOps portfolio — scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, and risks — and keep them current enough that leadership trusts them.
  • Run the operating cadence of the function including standups and weekly workstream reviews
  • Surface risks, blockers, and competing priorities early, and drive them to a decision rather than logging them and waiting.
  • Produce clear, honest status reporting for GTM and executive stakeholders — what's on track, what isn't, and what you need from them.

Sales Tools Implementation (Program Delivery, Not Build)

  • Serve as day-to-day program lead for new GTM vendor tools
  • Partner closely with our Salesforce Technical Lead to understand deliverable dates 
  • Gather and document business requirements from GTM stakeholders and translate them into clear, unambiguous specifications the technical lead or an implementation partner can work from.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing: build test plans, recruit testers, track defects to closure, and hold the line on go/no-go criteria.
  • Own cutover, launch, communication, and plans so new tools land cleanly instead of quietly failing to get adopted.

Vendor and Partner Management

  • Manage relationships with software vendors, systems integrators, and consulting firms — scoping statements of work, tracking deliverables against them, and escalating when delivery slips.
  • Support procurement, renewal, and license true-up cycles in partnership with Finance, Legal, and IT Security.
  • Track spend and utilization across the GTM tech stack and flag redundancy or underuse.

Enablement and Training

  • Build the training materials that make new processes and tools stick: quick reference guides, process documentation, recorded walkthroughs, and live training sessions.
  • Own and curate the RevOps knowledge base so the answer is findable without asking a person.
  • Deliver enablement and measure whether adoption actually moved.
  • Support onboarding for new GTM hires on systems, process, and tooling.
  • Utilize Claude CoWork to optimize wherever possible

Keeping RevOps Running

  • Act as the intake point for RevOps requests — triage, prioritize, route, and close the loop with requesters. 
  • Manage the project plan in Wrike
  • Document the processes the team relies on and improve them where they're brittle, manual, or undocumented.
  • Pick up the unglamorous work that keeps a lean team effective, from data hygiene pushes to meeting prep to writing the thing nobody has written yet.

What We're Looking For:

Required:

  • 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, ideally supporting a go-to-market, revenue operations, sales operations, or business systems function..
  • Exceptional organizational skills. You build the plan, keep it accurate, and are the single source of truth on status. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.
  • Proficiency with Google Sheets, Presentations, and Documents. Ability to analyze data via pivot tables and vlookup is foundational. You enjoy and thrive in data-driven environments
  • Strong interpersonal skills. You can earn trust across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Engineering, push back on a vendor without damaging the relationship, and get a decision out of a room of busy people.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. Requirements, status updates, training docs, and executive summaries — with the judgment to know which one the moment calls for.
  • Hands-on and self-directed. Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where the process may not exist yet, and willing to build it.
  • Vendor management experience. Track record managing external vendors, consultants, or systems integrators through a full delivery cycle.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, capital markets, or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with blockchain, distributed ledger technology, tokenization, or digital assets — or genuine curiosity about them.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Granola, Wispr Flow, Clay, Claude CoWork
  • PMP or an equivalent project or program management certification.
  • Experience building sales enablement or training content for a distributed, global team.
  • Exposure to enterprise or complex sales cycles with long timelines and many stakeholders.

Why This Role:

You'll be the operational center of gravity for a function that directly determines how well Digital Asset sells. The RevOps team is small enough that your work is visible and your judgment matters, and the company is at a stage where the systems and processes you build will still be in use years from now. You'll do it in service of a mission that is unusually concrete: rebuilding the infrastructure that global financial markets run on.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed. If you're excited about the work and think you'd be good at it, we'd like to hear from you.

The range below may vary if based outside the New York tri-state area (New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut). Base salaries are determined during our interview process, during which we assess the candidate's experience, skills, and capabilities against internal peers and the scope and responsibilities of the position.

US Pay Transparency
$120,000—$150,000 USD

At Digital Asset, we are committed to compensation structures that reward impact consistently across our global teams. We support our people at every stage of life with comprehensive, family-forward benefits and flexible working models designed to help you do your best work.

Benefits We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being of our team members. Health and insurance benefits vary by region to ensure local relevance and compliance, and may include medical, dental, and vision coverage. 

Equal Opportunity Employer Digital Asset is an equal opportunity employer committed. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, citizenship status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

About the company

Trust Wallet is the leading non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet, trusted by over 200 million people worldwide to securely manage and grow their digital assets. Our vision is to give individuals the freedom to own their assets, confidently participate in the future economy, and access opportunities that enhance their lives. Our mission is to be a trusted personal companion — helping users safely navigate Web3, the on-chain economy, and the emerging AI-powered future. With support for over 10 million assets across 100+ blockchains, Trust Wallet offers a seamless, multi-chain experience backed by industry-leading self-custody technology, a vibrant community, and a growing ecosystem of partners.

Trust Wallet is looking for a Customer Support Lead to lead and scale our customer support function while driving operational excellence, technical problem-solving, and AI-enabled support innovation.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will manage and develop the customer support team, improve support processes and service quality, and work cross-functionally to enhance the user experience. We’re looking for someone who combines strong support leadership and technical troubleshooting skills with hands-on experience operating and improving AI-powered support. You will own service standards, support knowledge, and operational outcomes across AI and human support, partnering with the AI Platform team on quality evaluation and rollout readiness. The AI Platform team owns model, tool, and system implementation.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and manage Trust Wallet’s customer support team, including team performance, coaching, hiring, and development

  • Own day-to-day support operations across AI and human channels and ensure high-quality, timely resolution of user issues

  • Handle complex or escalated support cases, especially those involving technical product issues

  • Build scalable support processes, workflows, and knowledge management systems; own the review and maintenance of guidance to keep it accurate, current, and consistent across AI and human support

  • Identify opportunities to improve user experience through better support operations and cross-functional collaboration

  • Partner closely with product, engineering, operations, and other internal teams to resolve issues and surface user feedback

  • Define and track support performance across SLA, CSAT, resolution time, backlog, verified resolution, repeat contacts, escalation quality, and cost per resolved issue; monitor incorrect or unsafe AI responses

  • Continuously improve AI support, automation, agent assist, and self-service through regular reviews of conversations and unresolved cases; turn findings into knowledge updates, workflow changes, evaluation cases, and prioritized product or engineering requirements

  • Define and maintain human escalation policies for high-risk cases, repeated failures, and explicit requests for human support; plan staffing and train the team to manage handoffs effectively

  • Partner with the AI Platform team on acceptance criteria, rollout readiness, and post-launch monitoring, using customer outcomes and safety checks to guide expansion

  • Help shape the long-term strategy for a modern, scalable, and tech-enabled customer support organization

What we’re looking for

  • Experience leading and managing customer support or customer service teams

  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills, including the ability to reproduce issues, interpret relevant logs and API information, use blockchain explorers, and provide actionable evidence to engineering teams

  • Working knowledge of wallet transactions, networks, fees, and common security issues, with sound judgment around sensitive information and situations requiring escalation

  • Experience in designing or improving support operations, workflows, and service quality

  • Hands-on experience operating or improving AI-powered customer support in production, with clear examples of your contribution and measurable outcomes

  • Practical understanding of AI support limitations, knowledge retrieval, conversation evaluation, and human handoff, with the ability to turn observed failures into actionable improvements

  • Ability to think strategically while also being hands-on in execution

  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

  • Experience in crypto, Web3, fintech, or technology-driven companies is a strong plus

Preferred

  • Experience supporting consumer-facing digital products

  • Familiarity with support platforms, CRM systems, help centers, chatbot tools, and AI support tooling

  • Understanding of wallets, blockchain, crypto, or Web3 user issues

  • Experience building or scaling support teams in a global environment

  • Experience with support analytics, SQL, low-code automation, or lightweight scripting to investigate issues and improve workflows

Additional Information
