Join us as Managing Director at a MiCAR-regulated company Vienna, Austria!

Requirements

  • The candidate must be a fit and proper person as defined by the Austrian Financial Market Authority (FMA) and the Company's internal Fit & Proper Policy, possessing integrity, competence, and experience suitable for managing a regulated Crypto-Asset Service Provider (CASP).
  • Master's or Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience in financial services, fintech, or crypto-asset businesses, with direct accountability for AML/CFT compliance outcomes in at least part of that experience.
  • Proven track record in managing regulated financial institutions or compliance-intensive businesses.
  • Strong knowledge of crypto-asset technologies, markets, and regulations.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, or directly overseeing an AML/CFT compliance programme (customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, suspicious activity/transaction reporting) within a regulated financial services or crypto-asset business.
  • Prior experience acting as, or working in close coordination with, an Anti-Money Laundering Officer (AMLO) / Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).
  • Working knowledge of the EU AML/CFT framework beyond its Austrian transposition, including AMLD5/6, the forthcoming AML Regulation (AMLR), and FATF Recommendations as applied to crypto-asset service providers
  • Experience liaising with the Austrian Financial Intelligence Unit (Geldwäschemeldestelle) or an equivalent FIU, including suspicious transaction reporting
  • Strong understanding of regulatory obligations under MiCA/MiCAR and the Austrian legal framework applicable to CASPs, in particular:
  1. Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG) - the Austrian Financial Markets Anti-Money Laundering Act; under Art 23 FM-GwG, the Management Board holds overall responsibility for establishing and resourcing adequate AML/CFT internal controls.
  2. Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018) and Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 (ZaDiG 2018), relevant to internal audit, governance, and conduct obligations applied to the Company.
  3. Sanktionengesetz (SanktG) and related EU/Austrian sanctions and restrictive measures frameworks.
  4. Austrian Criminal Code (Strafgesetzbuch, StGB) and Finanzstrafgesetz (FinStrG), relevant to personal integrity and "no criminal record" fit & proper requirements.
  5. Wirtschaftliche Eigentümer Registergesetz (WiEReG), relevant to beneficial ownership disclosure obligations of the Company's management.
  6. FMA Rundschreiben (circulars) on internal organisation, risk analysis, and reporting obligations.
  • Being subject to approval by the FMA as fit and proper, as part of the licensing and ongoing supervisory process.
  • Demonstrated personal and professional integrity.
  • No criminal record or history of bankruptcy.
  • Excellent leadership, strategic thinking, and decision-making skills.
  • Fluency in English and German (German is the FMA's official working language for supervisory correspondence, submissions, and on-site meetings).
  • The candidate must reside in Austria and actively participate in day-to-day management. In line with the Company's Governance Policy, the Management Board must at all times include at least two managing directors resident in the EU and approved fit & proper by the FMA, with at least one managing director readily accessible to the FMA at all times and at least one accessible to staff at the Company's seat; managing directors must coordinate leave and travel so both requirements remain met.
  • Willingness and ability to act jointly with the second managing director in representing the Company (four-eye principle) in line with the Company's Articles of Association and Austrian corporate law.

Responsibilities

  • Define and implement the strategic direction of the company in alignment with MiCA requirements.
  • Ensure operational efficiency and scalability of services related to crypto-asset trading, custody, and exchange.
  • Lead high-level business decisions and ensure the financial sustainability of the business.
  • Supervise the preparation of annual reports, board minutes, and oversee external and internal audits.
  • Ensure full and ongoing compliance with the MiCA Regulation, Austrian FMA guidelines, and related EU directives (e.g., AMLD5, PSD2 and DORA), as well as the Austrian FM-GwG, WAG 2018, ZaDiG 2018, SanktG, and WiEReG.
  • Act as the principal point of contact for the regulator, including serving as the managing director designated as readily accessible to the FMA and able to provide requested information at all times, per the Company's Governance Policy.
  • Take direct ownership of the Company's AML/CFT compliance framework, ensuring the adequacy of customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, screening, and suspicious activity/transaction reporting processes, in close coordination with the AMLO and the Chief Compliance Officer.
  • Approve and periodically review the Company's Customer and Country Risk Assessment Methodology and business-wide ML/TF risk assessment, and ensure the AML/CFT function is adequately resourced as required under Art 23 FM-GwG.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting to the Austrian Financial Intelligence Unit (Geldwäschemeldestelle) and full cooperation with law enforcement and regulatory requests relating to money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions.
  • Ensure robust implementation of sanctions screening and asset-freezing obligations under SanktG and applicable EU restrictive measures regulations.
  • Serve as escalation point for material AML/CFT findings, ensuring timely internal escalation to the Management Board and, where legally required, external reporting to competent authorities.
  • Co-chair, together with the other managing director, the bi-weekly Management Board meetings, covering AML/CFT/sanctions matters, business and financial reports, cybersecurity, licensing updates, and HR matters, and ensure minutes are produced and circulated.
  • Ensure the company maintains effective governance, risk, and compliance frameworks, including upholding the Company's Fit & Proper Policy for initial and ongoing suitability assessments of managing directors and Key Function Holders.
  • Oversee the management of prudential safeguards, asset segregation, and security of client funds and crypto-assets.
  • Regularly review the Company's Articles of Association and, where applicable, Management Board by-laws to ensure continued compliance with Austrian and EU regulatory requirements
  • Represent the company to stakeholders, partners, regulators, and investors, acting jointly with the second managing director (four-eye principle) for acts of representation.
  • Sign regulatory submissions and disclosures as required under MiCA, FM-GwG, and national corporate law.
  • Maintain transparency and timely communication with shareholders and board members.

descriptions.job-18xouql:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world’s leading financial institutions, like Mastercard, Visa, Robinhood, and PayPal.

About the Team

The Compliance & Platform Experience team owns the shared surfaces that power trust and usability across Paxos's platform — from identity verification and compliance workflows to the dashboards, notifications, and developer tools that make our platform seamless to integrate with and give partners real product surface area to build on. We sit at the intersection of product, compliance, and engineering, proving that regulatory rigor and a great user experience aren't a tradeoff — they're the same problem.

The Opportunity

This is a rare seat: full ownership of how Paxos brings the world's largest financial institutions onto its platform. The Senior Product Manager will own the end-to-end onboarding experience — from the identity verification, KYC/KYB, and compliance workflows that bring new customers on, through the dashboard and developer experiences that make integration seamless and get them fully activated. You'll partner directly with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Design and Engineering to build the roadmap that turns regulatory complexity into a competitive advantage — including pioneering how AI agents take on compliance work at a scale few companies have attempted.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and activation experience — from identity verification and KYC/KYB through a customer's first meaningful use of the platform — partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Design, and Engineering

  • Set the roadmap for the Paxos Dashboard, the primary surface where customers manage their accounts, transact, and access reporting

  • Shape our compliance AI agent strategy, identifying where automation can replace manual work across onboarding and ongoing operations

  • Own vendor relationships and integrations across the KYC/KYB and transaction monitoring stack

  • Build the platform tooling and infrastructure that enables other Paxos teams to deliver five-star experiences in their own products

About You

  • 6+ years of product management experience, ideally at a high-growth technology company

  • Hands-on crypto industry experience at a regulated firm such as an exchange or custodian

  • Strong grasp of the global regulatory landscape shaping crypto compliance

  • Skilled at stakeholder management, with a track record of aligning executives around competing priorities

  • Experience owning a broad, cross-functional portfolio — spanning compliance, operations, money movement, notifications, reporting, and developer tooling

  • Data-informed in how you prioritize, using metrics to make the case for trade-offs across a wide-ranging portfolio

Nice to Haves

  • Experience evaluating and procuring vendors in a compliance context

  • History of partnering closely with compliance or legal teams

  • Familiarity with transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, or case management tools

  • End-to-end ownership of KYC/KYB or identity-related product areas

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

  • Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers

  • We only use @paxos.com email addresses

  • We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

  • For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!
descriptions.job-0t7mkyl:
Reports to: Regional Head of Compliance, EMEA (with matrix reporting to the OEM Board and Global Compliance) 

Regulator: Malta Financial Services Authority (MFSA) 

About the Team

The compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance culture at the company. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company's AML and regulatory obligations and enterprise risks.

OKX Europe Markets Limited is our MFSA-authorised investment services entity. Its licence covers the operation of a multilateral trading facility alongside our MiFID derivatives business. Operating a trading venue puts a distinct set of obligations on the firm: venue rulebook governance, member admission, market surveillance, transparency and reporting, systems resilience and orderly trading controls. This role owns compliance for that venue.

What You Will Be Doing

As Head of Compliance for the MTF, you will hold the MiFID compliance function for the trading venue and act as the MFSA-approved person for that role. The MLRO function sits separately; you will work alongside the OEM MLRO on financial crime matters that touch venue activity.

You will:

  • Own the MTF compliance framework end to end: policies, procedures, controls, registers and the compliance monitoring programme covering MiFID II, MiFIR, MAR and the MFSA Investment Services Rules applicable to MTF operators.
  • Act as the primary compliance point of contact for the MFSA on venue matters: authorisation variations, notifications, thematic reviews, RFIs, inspections and remediation.
  • Own the venue rulebook. Keep it current, ensure it is enforceable, and run the governance process for changes.
  • Oversee member and participant admission: eligibility criteria, non-discriminatory access, direct electronic access arrangements, sponsored access controls, and ongoing monitoring of members' compliance with the rules of the venue.
  • Oversee admission to trading of financial instruments, including the compliance assessment of new instruments, product classes and tokenised or DLT-based instruments where relevant.
  • Provide compliance oversight of orderly trading requirements: systems capacity and resilience, testing of members' algorithms, circuit breakers, order-to-trade ratios, tick sizes, market making schemes and clock synchronisation.
  • Provide compliance oversight of pre- and post-trade transparency, waivers and deferrals, transaction reporting, reference data and the accuracy and completeness controls behind them.
  • Advise the business on the interaction between the MTF and OKX's wider European footprint: the MiFID derivatives business, MiCA-authorised activity in OKX Europe Ltd, and the DLT Pilot Regime where a DLT MTF is in scope.
  • Deliver the annual compliance risk assessment, the compliance monitoring plan and the compliance report to senior management and the Board.
  • Build, lead and develop the MTF compliance team, and set the compliance training curriculum for venue-facing staff, trading operations and technology.
  • Give day-to-day advice to product, engineering, trading operations, legal and market operations in a fast-moving regulatory environment, including sign-off on venue changes, launches and marketing where required.
  • Oversee compliance aspects of outsourcing, critical third parties and operational resilience, including DORA obligations relevant to the venue.
  • Prepare Board, committee and matrix stakeholder reporting, and represent OKX with the MFSA, ESMA consultations, industry bodies and peer venue forums.

What We Look For in You

  • 10 years plus in regulatory compliance within financial services, market infrastructure, fintech or crypto, including time at a senior or head-of-function level.
  • Direct experience of trading venue compliance: MTF, OTF, regulated market, SI or an equivalent execution venue. This is the core requirement.
  • Working knowledge of MiFID II and MiFIR as they apply to venue operators: Articles 18–20 and 31 (MTF operating requirements and rule monitoring), Articles 48–50 (orderly trading), MiFIR transparency and transaction reporting, and the associated RTS.
  • Practical experience of market abuse surveillance and MAR obligations for a venue operator, including STOR decision-making.
  • Experience developing and owning a compliance framework that has stood up to regulatory examination, and a track record of engaging supervisors directly.
  • Experience preparing and defending compliance reporting to a board or regulator.
  • Familiarity with MFSA Investment Services Rules and Malta's regulatory environment, or a demonstrable ability to get there quickly from another EEA jurisdiction.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to run several regulatory workstreams to deadline.
  • Comfortable working independently and in a dispersed, cross-border team across multiple varied tasks.
  • Highly ethical, intuitive, and willing to question and challenge at every level of the business.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain venue regulation to engineers and commercial teams.
  • Eligible for MFSA approval as the holder of the compliance function.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Haves

  • Prior experience in the crypto industry, particularly tokenised instruments, crypto derivatives or a MiCA-authorised trading platform.
  • Experience with the DLT Pilot Regime or another distributed ledger market infrastructure.
  • Experience of a trading venue authorisation or a licence variation to add MTF operation.
  • Familiarity with surveillance platforms (Nasdaq Trade Surveillance, Eventus, Scila, Steeleye or similar) and with transaction reporting tooling.
  • International Compliance Association, ACAMS, CISI or equivalent compliance certification.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances 
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants 
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

OKX Statement:

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.



Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.
descriptions.job-0r11sgt:
Driving the next generation of wealth.

Digital assets are redefining how wealth is created, used, and transferred. Since 2018 at Nexo, we have been building the future model of financial wealth - dynamic, accessible, and designed for a new generation of forward-thinking investors.

But technology alone doesn’t drive progress. People do.

We are a team of builders, strategists, analysts, creatives, and operators united by a shared mindset: advancement. We move fast, think long term, and take ownership. We challenge ideas, not people. We value clarity over noise and impact over optics.

What makes Nexo different?

We shape industry trends. We rethink how wealth works and build solutions that reflect that belief.

That requires a certain kind of person.

You will thrive here when you think independently and act decisively, take ownership without waiting for permission, and care deeply about quality, long-term value, and disciplined execution. The people who succeed at Nexo bring analytical depth, sound judgment, and resilience - but also curiosity and the drive to keep improving.

This is an environment for people who want to lead, create, and elevate what already exists. If building what’s next excites you, you’ll feel at home at Nexo.

Official website: nexo.com

Your role:

  • Assess applicable regulatory requirements in multiple jurisdictions and ensure that Nexo's business activity is carried out in full compliance therewith.
  • Liaise with all relevant departments to ascertain current compliance levels across Nexo's business activity in multiple jurisdictions.
  • Participate in and supervise reviews of existing data sets to crosswalk available documents and identify gaps, conduct regular audits in all required areas to ascertain compliance levels, and develop and implement compliance improvement plans where required.
  • Provide training and education to team members regarding compliance, and ensure that all of them are aware of the procedures to be followed to adhere to compliance requirements.
  • Supervise junior and regular team members.
  • Prepare reports, where necessary, for senior management.
  • Assist regulators with completing site visits and external audits, and prepare for and conduct audits alongside external authorities.
  • Work in close cooperation and actively communicate with regional legal counsels and regulators.
  • Keep up to date with industry standards and best practices in virtual assets, banking, FinTech, and RegTech.

What makes you stand out:

  • Master’s degree in law.
  • Strong academic record.
  • Minimum relevant professional experience in a corporate environment of 3-5 years, including in the field of compliance, credit, payment institution and banking licensing. Any experience in cryptocurrencies and blockchain is a strong advantage.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to comprehend how new regulations will impact Nexo’s products and expansion plans.
  • Ability to assess and mitigate regulatory risks.
  • Ability to solve complex problems and apply interdisciplinary thinking.
  • Advanced multi-tasking skills.
  • Outstanding analytical, prioritizing, problem-solving and planning skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to the delegated tasks and responsibilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fluid, fast-paced environment and meet deadlines; ability to work independently but within one strong team.
  • Curiosity and a strong desire to learn, grow and be up-to-date with the trends and the best practices in virtual assets, banking, FinTech and RegTech.

Nexo benefits:

  • Competitive and rewarding remuneration package.
  • Annual performance-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive Learning Hub for continuous growth.
  • Hybrid work model: primarily office-based with scheduled home office flexibility.
  • A dynamic and inspiring environment with cutting-edge projects.
  • Career development opportunities in a global leader driving the next generation of wealth.
  • Customizable personal benefits package.
  • Wellness benefits include additional health insurance, all-access sports cards, team-wide sports activities, standing desks, and blue light glasses.
  • Free parking with a designated space, free electric bikes, and public transportation cards.
  • Fresh fruits, snacks, and a well-stocked office kitchen.
  • Regular department team buildings and company-wide team buildings.

About Chainalysis Government Solutions

Chainalysis Government Solutions (CGS) is a wholly-owned Chainalysis subsidiary that provides blockchain intelligence solutions, including technology, training, and services to law enforcement, defense, intelligence, and regulatory customers across the U.S. Government.

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, investigate criminal cases, and track transnational threats. As the adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

About the Role

CGS is seeking a Systems Administrator — Government Deployments to operate, maintain, secure, and optimize Chainalysis technology within classified U.S. Intelligence Community environments. Serving as the hands-on systems administration authority for production environments supporting mission users, you will ensure deployed capabilities remain available, secure, performant, and compliant throughout their operational lifecycle.

In this role, you will work closely with customer system owners, technical stakeholders, and internal CGS teams (Technical Product, Forward-Deployed Engineering, Solution Architecture, Security, Product, and Engineering). You will focus on the sustainment and administration of approved production architectures rather than establishing new deployment architectures.

Please note: This position requires you to work physically on-site with customers in the Washington, D.C. Metropolitan Area up to five days per week.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Systems Administration & Production Operations: Install, configure, administer, maintain, and optimize Linux and Windows operating systems within C2S/AWS and approved government environments. Provision IaaS components (EC2, VPC, RDS, S3) and maintain web/application infrastructure (Apache, WSGI, PostgreSQL, WebLogic, VMware, OpenShift).

  • System Maintenance & Release Management: Lead upgrades, patching, configuration changes, and software release deployments within established architectures. Validate system prerequisites, coordinate maintenance windows, execute change procedures, and conduct post-deployment verification.

  • Security, Hardening & Compliance: Maintain systems in accordance with customer security requirements, Risk Management Framework (RMF), and Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs). Remediate vulnerabilities, configure security controls (firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection), and support security authorization audits.

  • Network & Integration Engineering: Configure, test, and troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLAN, firewall rules, and network monitoring concepts to enable authorized data transfer between Chainalysis environments and customer systems.

  • Backup, Recovery & Operational Resilience: Implement and maintain backup and recovery procedures, execute disaster recovery testing, validate data integrity, and identify single points of failure across deployed infrastructure.

  • Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a trusted technical partner to customer system owners and mission users. Provide technical support, develop runbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and route recurring field observations to internal CGS Product and Engineering teams.

Role Boundaries & Ownership

  • Systems Administrator (This Role): Owns production systems administration, sustainment, operational health, system configuration, maintenance, security hardening, and infrastructure troubleshooting within assigned customer environments.

  • Forward-Deployed Administrator: Owns execution and deployment implementation for new capabilities and major architectural updates before handing off sustainment to the Systems Administrator.

  • Virtualization expertise with technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V, or KVM.

     

  • Strong written documentation and troubleshooting skills, with an ownership mindset and an ability to operate independently within secure customer facilities.

At Coinme, we’re redefining access to financial services in a digital world. By combining the cutting-edge power of blockchain technology with everyday simplicity, we make digital currencies accessible and usable for all.

As the world's largest network of cryptocurrency kiosks with over 40,000 locations nationwide, we're breaking down barriers to crypto adoption through our seamless mobile app, secure digital wallet, and DeFi integrations. Beyond our consumer offerings, we're also the infrastructure powering the crypto revolution for businesses.

Through our enterprise Crypto-as-a-Service (CaaS) platform, we enable businesses to launch crypto capabilities in weeks, not months. Our modular, API-first infrastructure provides everything from KYC and payment processing to liquidity and custody solutions—all fully licensed and compliant.

We’re big enough to lead the charge in decentralized finance but small enough that your ideas will make waves. Every role at Coinme contributes to building a financial future where everyone has the tools to thrive. At Coinme, your growth fuels our mission. Together, we RISE.

Technical Solutions Engineer, Payments

About the Role

Coinme is part of Polygon Labs, and together we're building the Open Money Stack: one integration for wallets, compliance, fiat on and off ramps, and settlement. Coinme brings the regulated US fiat layer, built over nearly a decade with money transmitter licenses, 50,000+ retail locations, and over $1B processed. The stack is live and fintechs and financial institutions are integrating it now.

This role owns the technical experience of building on us: our API documentation and integration path, the technical answers partners need during a sales conversation, and getting signed partners from kickoff to production. You'd be defining what good looks like, with the room to set the standard and the mandate to hold it. The bar we're setting is the best developer experience in payments: a competent developer working with an AI coding assistant should be able to integrate us without needing to talk to us at all.

This is a senior individual contributor role with deep technical ownership.

What You'll Do

  • Own the API and integration docs. Rewrite what's wrong, fill what's missing, keep it current as the stack changes
  • Build the quickstarts, sample code, and reference architectures that get a developer from nothing to a working integration
  • Answer technical questions from partners during sales conversations and during builds, and resolve them yourself rather than passing them to engineering
  • Take signed partners live: requirements intake, provisioning once KYB and KYC clear, sandbox testing, webhooks, go-live checks
  • Work with the integration program manager on timelines so partners know what's coming and when
  • Learn the stack deeply: CaaS ramps, Sequence wallets, Trails, OMSX, bank rails, custodial and non-custodial flows, virtual accounts, deposit addresses, webhooks
  • Build demos and sample apps that BD can use to show what the products do
  • Push what you learn back into Product and Engineering. You'll see every rough edge in the API before anyone else does
  • Automate the repetitive parts of onboarding and provisioning, and use AI tools to move faster on docs and support

Who You Are

You've worked in US payments and you know the rails: fund flows, settlement, reconciliation, and how money actually moves here. US payments has its own rules and its own failure modes, and this role needs someone who has already lived in it.

Beyond that, we're open on where you're coming from. You may have run API integrations for customers at a payments or fintech company, taking them from kickoff to production. Or you may have owned docs, SDKs, or developer support at an API-first payments company. Either path works.

You should also have:

  • Hands-on US payments experience. You've worked ACH, RTP, wires, card rails, or an equivalent, and you understand settlement and reconciliation in practice, not in theory
  • Real hands-on API skills. You can read logs, debug a broken webhook, reason about auth, and work in Postman or Bruno and Datadog. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you do need to solve problems instead of routing them
  • Strong technical writing. You can take a messy system and document it so a stranger can follow it
  • Patience for ambiguity. The stack changes weekly, the docs are thin, and nobody is going to hand you a plan
  • Comfort using AI tools in your daily work, and an eye for how to make our docs work well for developers who are using them too

Nice to Have

  • Crypto or stablecoin experience, especially wallets and on-chain settlement. You can learn it here, but having seen it will shorten your ramp meaningfully
  • Early-stage or smaller company experience where you've built something without a playbook
  • Enough coding to build a demo app
  • Experience with a docs platform like Mintlify
  • Exposure to KYB and KYC tooling

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia.

To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/

Position Overview

We are seeking a Staff AI Scheduling & Orchestration Engineer to lead the workload placement logic that defines our AI-native NeoCloud platform. Standard Kubernetes scheduling is insufficient for the demands of large-scale AI; you will be responsible for eliminating "GPU stranding" and maximizing utilization across our expensive compute fleets. This role is pivotal in building a high-performance scheduling fabric that understands the physical realities of our hardware—from NVLink-connected GPU topologies to InfiniBand interconnects. You will work at the intersection of distributed systems and AI, driving the architectural decisions that enable our platform to handle massive-scale distributed training and inference jobs with industry-leading efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement advanced batch scheduling architectures using frameworks like Volcano or YuniKorn to support multi-node gang scheduling.
  • Develop and manage cluster-wide admission control and sophisticated job queueing mechanisms utilizing Kueue to manage high-volume AI workload traffic.
  • Leverage Kubernetes Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) and custom scheduler plugins to manage complex accelerator requests natively.
  • Architect topology-aware pod placement strategies that optimize for low-latency communication via NVLink and InfiniBand fabrics.
  • Implement automated GPU sharing technologies (e.g., MIG, time-slicing) and multi-tenancy isolation policies to maximize cluster-wide utilization.
  • Collaborate with the GPU Systems and Storage teams to ensure the scheduling layer is tightly integrated with bare-metal hardware and storage I/O patterns.
  • Drive the reliability and scalability of the scheduling stack, resolving resource contention and deadlock scenarios in large-scale HPC environments.
  • Mentor junior engineers and conduct design reviews to maintain architectural excellence in our orchestration layer.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of distributed systems engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in Kubernetes scheduling frameworks and orchestrators.
  • Extensive experience with AI workload execution patterns and distributed training frameworks (e.g., PyTorch Distributed, Ray, MPI).
  • Proven track record of operating, debugging, and scaling scheduling stacks in high-performance computing (HPC) or large-scale production cloud environments.
  • Strong knowledge of GPU hardware architectures and the specific scheduling challenges related to distributed AI training and inference.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Go-based Operators).
  • Excellent technical communication and leadership skills; ability to influence cross-functional teams and align architectural goals.

Financial Operations & Money Movement 

  • Own end-to-end financial operations for the consumer business — deposits, withdrawals, settlements, and reconciliation — across both fiat and cryptocurrency assets, at scale.
  • Define and manage SLAs for customer-impacting operational metrics (withdrawal processing time, transaction success rate, dispute resolution turnaround).

Team & Org Leadership 

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing operations team (reconciliation, asset movement, support ops), including workforce planning for distributed or outsourced functions as volume grows.
  • Own consumer-facing incident response for operational disruptions (failed withdrawals, settlement delays, banking/exchange outages), including customer communication protocols during incidents.

  • Drive operational readiness for new product launches and geographic expansions — financial infrastructure, licensing/regulatory dependencies, and go-live runbooks — in partnership with Product, Compliance, and Engineering.

  • Partner with Compliance and Legal to operationalize AML, fraud prevention, and KYC-related controls affecting consumer transactions; own fraud-loss and chargeback/dispute metrics for the consumer book.
  • Partner with Treasury on liquidity and cash positioning for consumer-facing flows, ensuring operational execution aligns with Treasury's risk and funding strategy.
  • Own vendor management and performance monitoring for payment processors and banking partners — uptime, fee structures, dispute rates, and relationship health.

  • Analyze operational and financial data (transaction success rates, time-to-resolution, cost-per-transaction) to drive strategic decisions and continuously improve performance.

  • Strong working knowledge of AML, KYC, and fraud-prevention frameworks, with experience partnering closely with Compliance rather than owning policy directly.

  • Demonstrated success driving operational readiness for new product launches or geographic market expansions, including navigating regulatory dependencies.

descriptions.job-1dzcmxp:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is a global payments infrastructure with deep emerging markets expertise. Businesses use us to access US dollars, manage treasury, and move money across borders.

Our focus now is scaling our dollar account product for businesses, a single account to hold dollars and stablecoins, manage treasury, and collect and disburse local currencies, and deepening the payment rails and currency coverage behind it.

The Role

You will own how we generate and convert B2B demand: paid, ABM, and outbound, plus the data, systems, and handoffs that connect all three to pipeline.

Our buyers are treasurers, treasury directors, and CFOs at large multinationals. Cycles are long, buying committees have several people in them, and our target accounts are named and finite. Depth inside a known list of accounts matters more than volume.

Marketing is a small team, so how you build matters as much as what you run. We are looking for someone who automates their own function rather than absorbing more manual work as the program grows: workflows that handle research, enrichment, list building, routing, and reporting, so your time goes to judgment and strategy. If your instinct when a task repeats is to build something that does it for you, this is the right seat.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will own the marketing-sourced pipeline number and be measured on cost efficiency as well as volume.

What you'll do

  • Run paid acquisition. Paid search, paid social, and retargeting, in the platforms yourself rather than through an agency. Move budget toward whatever produces qualified pipeline at the best cost per lead.
  • Own the ABM program. Execute against named accounts in commodities, logistics, mining, FMCG, pharmaceutical, and manufacturing. Build and tier the lists with sales, then run plays across ads, email, content, and outbound.
  • Build the outbound motion with sales: sequencing, messaging, list building, deliverability, and the tooling behind it.
  • Design the system, not just the campaigns. With marketing operations, own the model connecting spend to pipeline: what counts as qualified, the scoring and routing logic, campaign taxonomy, handoff thresholds with sales, and tracking at every stage. When a channel underperforms, you should be able to point to the stage that broke.
  • Automate your own function. Build the workflows that take repetitive work off your plate: account research and enrichment, list building, lead routing and alerting, campaign reporting, and first-draft copy and creative production. We use n8n, Claude, and Salesforce, and we treat this as core to the role rather than a side experiment. We would rather you spend a week building something that runs forever than do the task manually for a year.
  • Grow the supporting channels: nurture email, webinars, event follow-up, and landing-page conversion. Organic and AI search is an active channel for us, and you will coordinate with the content function on it.
  • Own the numbers. Cost per lead, cost per MQL, stage conversion, and pipeline contribution. You will own the definitions, not just the dashboards.

What we're looking for

  • Experience in B2B demand generation, growth, or performance marketing, with hands-on ownership of paid channels.
  • Pipeline you can point to, with a real handle on cost per lead and return on spend.
  • Experience running an ABM program against named accounts alongside sales.
  • Systems thinking. Evidence you have built the plumbing and not just the campaigns: lead scoring, routing rules, campaign taxonomy, attribution logic, or reporting models. Tell us about one you built or fixed.
  • Workflow automation. Automations you have built that took work off your plate, whether in n8n, Make, Zapier, Clay, or scripts, wired into a CRM or ad platform. Tell us what you built, what it replaced, and what still needs a human.
  • Fluency with funnel data. You can define a metric as well as read one, and you make budget calls from it. Salesforce a plus.
  • Comfort being the first person to build something, with little oversight, in a fast-moving team.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on with n8n, or another automation platform you have used beyond simple triggers.
  • Payments, fintech, or stablecoins, selling to enterprise or mid-market.
  • Experience selling into Africa, Latin America, or Asia.
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud

Ready to Join Us

Are you up for the challenge? Apply today and be part of shaping the future of FinTech. Let's innovate, disrupt, and lead together!

Senior Rust Engineer - High Frequency Trading (HFT)

About Keyrock

Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.

Today, we rock with over 200 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels, Singapore and Paris, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.

We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.

But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.

At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.

Mission statement

We are seeking a Senior Rust Engineer with deep trading systems experience and strong AWS knowledge to join our core Capital Markets division. Candidates with a passion for the Rust ecosystem and a proven track record designing, building, and operating mission-critical trading systems will be at a significant advantage.

As part of the engineering team in Capital Markets, you will take ownership of high-impact trading infrastructure, set technical direction in your domain, and drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and operability. You will join a highly-profitable, fast-paced division within Keyrock, where you will be expected to make a senior individual-contributor impact while collaborating with a global, fully-remote team. This role is open to candidates located in European time zones.

Job description

  • Design, develop, and optimise low-latency, mission-critical trading systems

  • Own key trading stack components end-to-end — from architecture through to production operation

  • Collaborate closely with quants, traders, and engineers to deliver solutions that improve trading performance and resilience

  • Maintain and evolve trading infrastructure with a focus on performance, stability, observability, and operational excellence

  • Troubleshoot complex production issues across exchange connectivity, execution, and market data handling

  • Drive engineering standards through technical leadership, code reviews, and mentoring

  • Embrace agentic engineering principles: leverage AI-assisted workflows, drive automation of operational tasks, and help evolve the team's agentic tooling

  • Contribute to functional, component, and production-readiness testing for critical trading components

Background and experience

Technical Skills

  • Production-grade Rust experience building high-performance, concurrent systems; proficiency with Tokio is a strong advantage

  • Hands-on experience in a systematic trading environment (HFT, Market Making, Quantitative Trading, or similar), with solid understanding of execution, market data, and operational risk

  • Strong AWS and Linux expertise, including cloud infrastructure trade-offs for latency-sensitive workloads, shell scripting, debugging, and production troubleshooting

  • Proficiency in Python or other scripting languages for strategy development, automation, and operational tooling

  • Deep familiarity with trading system protocols (FIX, REST, WebSocket), exchange connectivity, and market data feeds

  • Solid grasp of low-latency networking: TCP/UDP, packet and latency path analysis, dedicated network infrastructure, and kernel bypass techniques (DPDK)

  • Familiarity with agentic engineering tools and concepts: LLMs, MCP APIs, AI-First IDEs (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code), harness engineering, and workflow automation

  • Ability to make sound architectural decisions, articulate trade-offs clearly, and guide implementation across complex systems

Seniority & Competencies

  • Ownership & Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Deliver high-quality service, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.

  • Initiative & Problem-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.

  • Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.

  • Technical Leadership – Influence system design, raise engineering standards, mentor other engineers, and help the team make pragmatic, high-quality technical decisions.

  • Curiosity & Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.

  • Agentic Engineering – Embrace AI-assisted workflows and autonomous agents, pushing the boundaries of what engineering teams can achieve through intelligent automation.

  • Excellent Communication Skills with a team player mindset, collaborating within a fully remote global team.

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A senior engineer and crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership, raises the bar for others, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

Our offer

  • A competitive salary package

  • Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Team

Rain is seeking a seasoned Account Manager to join our team, with a dedicated focus on our most strategic accounts. These relationships carry outsized revenue and reputational weight for Rain and require a high-touch, white-glove, deeply relationship-driven servicing model. In this role, you will be a key player in managing these top accounts end-to-end: driving expansions and renewals, leading QBRs, and ensuring Rain shows up as the best possible partner at every stage of the relationship. You will operate in a player-coach model, working closely alongside our existing senior and enterprise account managers.

What you’ll do

  • Embed directly into our most strategic accounts on day one

  • Own the senior relationship layer with key leaders across our partners and Rain

  • Unblock cross-functional issues fast by collaborate with internal teams to understand customer needs and tailor solutions to ensure needs are being exceeded

  • Drive revenue and deepen partnerships by identifying use-case expansion, upsell/cross-sell opportunities, and leading renewals, expansions, and QBRs end-to-end

  • Provide data-driven insights to enhance the user experience and ensure companies are making the most out of Rain's products

  • Set the enterprise account management operating rhythm: weekly account health reviews, escalation triage, and internal and third-party coordination on behalf of partners

  • Build the playbook for what dedicated enterprise servicing and relationship management looks like at Rain

  • Act as the primary advocate internally for our top accounts to make sure their needs shape how we prioritize and build

You are likely to succeed if you have:

  • 8+ years in account management, customer success, or strategic partnerships at a fintech, payments, or crypto company

  • A track record owning senior, executive-level client relationships, not just day-to-day account operations

  • Experience negotiating and managing complex commercial relationships involving legal, compliance, operational, technical, and executive stakeholders

  • Comfort operating without a large team on day one. This is a hands-on, embedded role for someone motivated by impact

  • Experience navigating escalations that require pulling in engineering, product, or compliance. You need to know how to get the right people in a room and hold them accountable

  • Senior roles at both large enterprises and startup or scale-up companies. Demonstrated ability to identify process improvements, build scalable solutions, and thrive in fast-moving, iterative environments

Bonus attributes:

  • Experience standing up a new team or function from scratch, rather than inheriting an existing one

  • Deep familiarity with stablecoins, cross-border payments infrastructure, and card issuing ecosystems

  • Existing network across fintech, banking, payments, stablecoin, or broader financial infrastructure ecosystems

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe's Money Management team helps businesses move, store, and manage money at global scale. Our product suite  spanning Connect, Payouts, Issuing, Treasury, Capital, and FX gives companies the infrastructure to build programmable fund flows, embed financial services into their platforms, and offer financing to their customers and sellers. In ANZ, we work with some of the region's most sophisticated enterprises and fastest-growing technology companies, helping them solve complex fund flow problems and unlock new financial product opportunities. It's an exciting time to be part of the team: Money Management is one of Stripe's highest-growth product areas and ANZ is a key market in that expansion.

What you’ll do

As one of Stripe's first Money Management Account Executives in ANZ, you'll have the opportunity to build something from the ground up. This is an IC role for someone who is energised by being an early hire  defining how we sell the full Money Management suite in the region, establishing relationships with some of ASEAN's most ambitious companies, and creating the playbook as you go. You'll develop pipeline across multiple high-growth markets and serve as a trusted partner to companies tackling complex financial infrastructure challenges from global platforms routing payouts to local gig workers, to fintechs embedding card issuance and treasury into their products.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full commercial cycle for Stripe's Money Management products  including Payouts, Issuing, Treasury, Capital, and FX  across a portfolio of enterprise and strategic accounts in ANZ

  • Navigate complex, multi-product deal structures in close collaboration with Solutions Architecture, Legal, Compliance, and Product teams
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers across ANZ's enterprise and high-growth technology sectors

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of enterprise sales or business development experience at a technology or fintech company, with a consistent track record of top performance on strategic accounts
  • Demonstrated experience selling payments, financial infrastructure, or fintech products to large enterprise customers

  • Strong ability to understand technical requirements and communicate complex solutions clearly to both technical and executive audiences

OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director of AI Enablement — a hands-on builder who turns AI strategy into shipped reality across business units. This is not a strategy-only or purely advisory role. We need someone who rolls up their sleeves: mapping how teams actually work today, spotting where AI can remove friction or unlock value, and then building — or driving the build of — the solution alongside the team that will use it.
The ideal candidate sits between execution and delivery: technical enough to prototype a working solution themselves, and operationally sharp enough to partner with engineering when a problem needs real infrastructure. Not a theorist, not a pure PM — someone who ships.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. AI Transformation Execution

Own execution of AI adoption projects end-to-end, business unit by business unit:
  • Embed with business teams (e.g. Compliance, Legal, CS) to understand existing workflows in detail and identify concrete gaps and pain points.
  • Translate identified gaps into practical AI-driven solution ideas — not abstract recommendations, but scoped proposals with a clear path to delivery.
  • Work directly alongside business teams to implement solutions (AI products, copilots, automated workflows, internal tools) and drive adoption post-launch.
  • Track and report on impact — efficiency gains, time saved, quality improvements — to justify continued investment and prioritize the next use case.
  • Build reusable playbooks and templates from each transformation project so lessons scale across other business units.

2. System Building & Technical Execution

Operate as the technical bridge between business needs and delivery, choosing the right execution path for each problem:
  • For larger, cross-functional initiatives: act as an AI PM — deeply understand business requirements, map them against existing company tech infrastructure, and partner with the relevant engineering/R&D teams to scope, prioritize, and drive delivery.
  • For smaller, high-velocity needs: personally build quick-win solutions (vibe-coding internal tools, lightweight automations, prompt-based workflows) and hand them directly to business teams for immediate use.
  • Maintain working knowledge of the company's AI tooling and infrastructure (internal copilots, MCP servers, knowledge base systems, agent frameworks) to know what can be reused vs. what needs to be built new.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI tools and techniques for applicability to internal use cases, and pilot them quickly and cheaply before recommending broader investment.

3. Organizational AI Enablement & Adoption

Support the broader AI enablement agenda at the ground level:
  • Help run AI literacy and enablement activities for non-technical business units, translating capability into concrete, adoptable use cases.
  • Contribute to and maintain internal AI playbooks, prompt libraries, and tooling documentation.
  • Act as a first point of contact for business units with an AI use-case idea — helping them scope it, prioritize it, and find the fastest path to a working solution.
  • Share learnings and reusable components back into the broader AI enablement function to avoid duplicated effort across teams.

What We Look For In You 

  • 4+ years of experience in a role combining project execution, product management, or technical delivery, with meaningful hands-on exposure to AI/LLM-based tools or products.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently build and ship practical AI-powered solutions (e.g. internal copilots, automation scripts, prompt-driven tools) — comfortable "vibe coding" a working prototype without waiting on a full engineering team.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills — able to sit with a non-technical business team, extract real requirements, and translate them into a scoped, deliverable solution.
  • Working understanding of the modern AI stack: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and agentic/automation frameworks — enough to have informed conversations with engineering, not necessarily to architect systems from scratch.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and switching between "hands-on builder" and "AI PM working with R&D" depending on the size and complexity of the initiative.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field (Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience).

Nice-To-Haves 

  • Experience in fintech, crypto/blockchain, or another regulated industry.
  • Prior experience working cross-functionally with Compliance, Legal, GBS, or similar non-P&E functions.
  • Familiarity with internal enterprise tooling ecosystems (Lark/Feishu, MCP-based integrations, internal data platforms).
  • Experience running or contributing to an internal AI Center of Excellence, enablement program, or similar cross-team initiative.

 

Perks & Benefits 

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

descriptions.job-03pjfa5:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Design team works across most projects at Stripe—from our brand standards to campaigns, events, digital products, and even printed publications. And since Stripe’s main audience is other people who build products, we agonize over and take pride in crafting user-friendly and user-focused experiences.

The Brand Design team lays the foundations that help Stripe accelerate. We do this by creating, evolving, and maintaining Stripe’s high-quality, versatile, and forward-looking visual identity design system. We sweat the details. We make it seem effortless.

Our team—and our design efforts—are multipliers for Stripe and Stripes. Our focus on principles, systems, and standards makes it easier for all Stripes to get work done—at a high quality bar, while still creating space for evolution and innovation. Collaborating with other teams at Stripe, as well as select external partners, we raise the quality and consistency of interactions with the Stripe brand.

Brand Designer leaders at Stripe demonstrate passion for great design and for expanding, evolving, defining, and documenting flexible design systems that achieve bar-raising quality and consistency for the brand at scale. They are user focused, have a strong understanding of the business, and are empathetic and inspiring team leaders. The ideal candidate excels across a variety of styles, crisply articulates design decisions, iterates quickly, and collaborates seamlessly with marketers, product managers, leaders, other designers, and agency partners.

About the role

The headline in a campaign that runs during a game break. The sentence in a developer's first API moment. The story in a 90-second film that makes a fintech company feel like something worth believing in. They all start as an idea, and they all carry the same responsibility: to be precise, surprising, and genuinely worth someone's attention.

We're looking for a Creative Director, Copy & Campaigns: someone who leads with language, thinks in concepts, and can also think in systems. This isn't a management role that occasionally writes, or a writing role that occasionally leads. It's both, fully. You'll generate the big campaign ideas and write the line that makes them land. You'll help set the creative vision for how Stripe shows up in the world, then stay close enough to the work to make it sharper. You'll direct agency partners without retreating into an approval layer. And you'll do the hard, underrated part of the job: selling the work through. That means building concepts strong enough that leadership buys them, and audiences buy into them.

You'll also help navigate genuinely new territory: how a category-defining infrastructure company earns a place in culture, not just through product launches, but through the moments that move people. AI is reshaping how creative work gets made, and we're not looking for someone who has it all figured out. We're looking for someone actively and curiously building toward what creativity can become in this moment, and excited to do that here.

If you want to run work at arm's length, this isn't the role. If you're excited by a role where the quality of your ideas, the sharpness of your copy, and the ambition you bring to the work all matter, this is a place to build.

What you’ll do

  • Own the words. Lead concepting and copy across global campaigns, from the insight that unlocks a campaign to the headline that earns a second look to the narrative that builds the brand. This is a thinking-and-writing role. Consistently, not occasionally.
  • Run campaigns end to end. Turn strategy into a sharp creative concept, then a clear POV, then work that ships across film, OOH, digital, and activations, distinctive at every touchpoint. Take ideas from blank page to bought to live.
  • Get the work bought. Develop concepts that hold up under scrutiny and present them so they win: to senior leadership, to cross-functional partners, and ultimately to the audiences they're built to move.
  • Lead Stripe's partnerships. Build creative strategies and executions that bring Stripe inside culture: sponsorship, storytelling, live moments.
  • Partner with agencies. Collaborate on sharp briefs. Push thinking at the concept stage, not just the polish stage. Give feedback that moves the work forward, and stay close enough to know where it needs to go and how to help it get there.
  • Build with AI, not just alongside it. Experiment actively in how you ideate and write, not to cut corners, but to expand what's possible. Build new workflows. Share what you learn.
  • Make everyone around you sharper. Help writers be more precise, designers find their voice, and marketers think with more creative ambition. Expect the same in return.
  • Shape what Stripe advertising becomes. Be a strong cross-functional voice connecting creative to business goals, user insights, and brand positioning. Raise the team's standards, ambitions, and culture of craft.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in copywriting and creative direction, with work that shows strong language craft, strategic thinking, and breakthrough campaign concepts, ideally for product-driven or tech companies.
  • 3+ years of experience managing teams, agencies, or creative partners in high-growth environments, with a clear ability to brief, concept, review, produce, and push work to a higher standard.
  • A portfolio led by ideas, language, and sharp conceptual thinking. You are actively generating concepts, writing, visibly shaping the work, and staying close to the craft.
  • A track record of selling ambitious work through: concepting ideas and presenting them in a way that earns buy-in from stakeholders and senior leadership without diluting them.
  • Strong instincts across film, digital, print, OOH, and activations, with a pulse on culture and the ability to turn insights into concepts that earn attention.
  • A genuine curiosity about AI in the creative process, including active experimentation and an honest perspective on how it can shape how creative work gets made.
  • A strong partnership mindset, especially with producer leads. You work closely together to drive program success, maintain quality, manage alignment, and keep the work moving with clarity.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, present to senior leadership, and bring people in on the creative.

Preferred qualifications

  •  Experience in sports marketing, sponsorship activations, or brand-in-culture work, with a perspective of how brands earn credibility in spaces they don't own.
  • Created concept-led work that generated real cultural traction and conversation, beyond media spend alone.
  • Built or contributed to voice and tone systems, copy standards, or brand language infrastructure.
  • Worked in environments where product and brand both had to work hard, and where the product itself was central to the story.
  • Created award-caliber work, with the perspective to know awards are not always the goal, but they do have an important place in raising ambition, sharpening craft, and building a team's creative standard.
